items.title: Territorial Acknowledgement
notes: Mayor McCabe opened the meeting with the following Territorial Acknowledgement:

We would like to begin by acknowledging that the land on which we gather (land on which we are broadcasting from) today is the land traditionally cared for by the Haudenosaunee, Anishinaabe and Chonnontan People. We also acknowledge the enduring presence and deep traditional knowledge and philosophies of the Indigenous People with whom we share this land today.

items.title: Moment of Reflection
notes: Mayor McCabe provided Council with a moment of reflection.
At the beginning of this Council meeting, we pause to think about the needs of our community. May we show wisdom and compassion in all our decisions.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
notes: No disclosure of pecuniary interest was declared by any member of Council at this point in the meeting.

items.title: Approval of Minutes
notes: That the previous meeting minutes be approved.

items.title: Wilfrid Laurier University
notes: Liz Brown, Director of Communications and Strategic Initiatives, Wilfrid Laurier University gave a presentation outlining the findings of the Economic and Social Impact Report and the Alumni Survey. Liz Brown then responded to questions of Council.
Matthew Grills, Director of Government and Community Relations, Wilfrid Laurier University also responded to questions of Council.

items.title: Citizen Relationship Management Demonstration
notes: Leslie Hepditch, Executive Officer to the CAO gave a presentation outlining how the new Citizen Relationship Management (CRM) portal works, and gave a demonstration on the water shutoff request form. Danielle Amos continued the demonstration showing what staff see when a request comes in. Megan Eby and Leslie Hepditch then showed how a work request comes in over the telephone. They then responded to questions of Council. Cari Van Niekerk also responded to questions of Council.

items.title: Consent Motion
notes: That consent motion items (a) through (h) be approved.

items.title: Items Removed From the Consent Motion
Advisory Committee of Council
notes: Natalia Chebel gave a presentation with the outcomes of the current committee review and advised Council of the next steps. She then responded to questions of Council.

items.title: Parkland/Facility Acquisition – Laurel Creek
notes: Greg Michalenko, Treasurer, Grand River Environmental Network spoke in support of the staff report, and the history of the Grand River Conservation Authority and Laurel Creek.
Robin Milne responded to questions of Council.

items.title: Regional All-Council Meeting
notes: Councillor Vasic attended the Kitchener-Waterloo Art Gallery’s Garden of Resilience launch yesterday, May 24. There are two gardeners in residence, sophia bartholomew and Shalaka Jadhav, and they have three talks planned this summer, rain or shine, at 101 Queen Street North in Kitchener. The gardeners are proposing a type of exchange of reciprocal garden visits, where if you attend their gardens, they would like to be invited to yours as well.
Mayor McCabe thanked everyone who submitted comments to Council for the Laurel Creek Nature Centre item.
